how_to_apply: Read the advertisement and the User Manual on the AMU Careers Portal.
Fill in the application form online at https://careers.amuonline.ac.in. Applications on plain paper are not accepted.
Pay the Rs. 500/- processing fee online, or upload the Disability Certificate if you are a PwD candidate.
After you submit the form, print the PDF of the application form on A-4 size paper.
Sign the printout and paste a recent front-facing photograph in the place marked for it.
Attach self-attested copies of all relevant documents.
On the top-left of the envelope, write the post applied for, the advertisement number (FM/41/2026) and its date.

Post it to the Office of the Dean, J. N. Medical College, Faculty of Medicine, Aligarh Muslim University, Aligarh-202002. It must arrive by 14 November 2026, 04:00 p.m. The University is not responsible for postal delays.

content_sections.heading: About AMU JNMC
content_sections.text: Jawaharlal Nehru Medical College is part of the Faculty of Medicine at Aligarh Muslim University in Aligarh, Uttar Pradesh. The college runs the J. N. Medical College Hospital. The Dean, Faculty of Medicine, issued this recruitment for the Department of Anatomy.

content_sections.heading: AMU JNMC Senior Resident/Tutor Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Indian nationals can apply. This includes Overseas Citizens of India (OCI) Cardholders under Section-7A of the Citizenship Act, 1955. Senior Resident/Tutor (Anatomy): As per NMC norms/Residency Scheme, adopted by AMU. The qualifications and experience the notice prescribes are the minimum. Meeting them does not guarantee a call for interview. Qualifications, experience and other eligibility conditions are counted as on the last date for submitting the application form. Any relaxation in the percentage of marks follows Government of India rules, where applicable. For Madrasa-background applicants, a certificate equivalent to High School or Graduation is accepted if it comes from a Madaris/Institution recognised by the University, where applicable. Only candidates with at least 40% of the relevant disability can apply for posts earmarked for PwD candidates. Covered categories: blindness and low vision (VH); deaf and hard of hearing (HH); locomotor disability including cerebral palsy, leprosy cured, dwarfism, acid-attack victims and muscular dystrophy (OH); autism, intellectual disability, specific learning disability and mental illness; and multiple disabilities from these categories, including deaf-blindness. The Disability Certificate must be issued by the Competent Authority on the proforma at Appendix-I. The proforma is available on amu.ac.in , amuregistrar.com and the AMU Careers Portal . The University's Medical Board checks the disability claim of the selected applicant before the appointment letter is issued. For the full discipline-specific eligibility of this post, see the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: A Local Selection Committee (LSC) interviews eligible candidates in the Office of the Dean, Faculty of Medicine, AMU, Aligarh. You must report half an hour before the LSC starts. The University will not issue a separate notice or interview letter for this LSC. The University may limit the number of candidates called for interview based on its rules or criteria. It may also set up a committee to scrutinise and shortlist applications. Selected applicants may be examined by an Internal Medical Board. If a mistake in scrutiny or selection is found at any stage, even after an interview or appointment letter is issued, the University may modify, withdraw or cancel the selection process.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: These are temporary teaching posts. Appointments are made on a purely temporary basis and can be ended at any time without notice or reasons.

Without them, you will not be allowed to appear. Forms that arrive late, are incomplete, or lack these supporting documents will be rejected without further consideration. faq.question: Q1. Which department are the Senior Resident/Tutor posts in?
faq.answer: All 05 posts are in the Department of Anatomy, Faculty of Medicine, Jawaharlal Nehru Medical College, AMU.

faq.question: Q2. Is there a difference in pay between Senior Resident and Tutor?
faq.answer: Both are at Pay Level AL-11. The Tutor post is AL-11 without NPA.

faq.question: Q3. Do I need to send a hard copy after applying online?
faq.answer: Yes. Post the signed printout with self-attested documents to the Office of the Dean, J. N. Medical College, Faculty of Medicine, AMU, Aligarh-202002. It must arrive by 14 November 2026, 04:00 p.m.

faq.question: Q4. What should I write on the envelope?
faq.answer: On the top-left of the envelope, write the post applied for, advertisement No. FM/41/2026 and its date, 28 October 2026.

faq.question: Q5. Are PwD candidates exempt from the fee?
faq.answer: Yes. PwD candidates do not pay the Rs. 500/- processing fee if they upload an authentic Disability Certificate on the prescribed proforma with the form.

faq.question: Q6. When and where is the interview?
faq.answer: The Local Selection Committee meets on 23 November 2026 at 12:30 p.m. in the Office of the Dean, Faculty of Medicine, AMU, Aligarh. Report by 12:00 noon.

faq.question: Q7. Will I receive an interview letter?
faq.answer: No. The University will not issue a separate notice or interview letter for this Local Selection Committee.

faq.question: Q8. What happens if I come to the interview without original documents?
faq.answer: You will not be allowed to appear before the interview. Bring the originals of all mark sheets, certificates, NMC registration, the experience certificate and the NOC or relieving orders.

faq.question: Q9. As on which date is eligibility counted?
faq.answer: Qualifications, experience and other conditions are counted as on the last date for submitting the application form.

faq.question: Q10. Who can I contact for help with the online form?
faq.answer: Call the Help Desk on +91-571-2700920 (Extension: 1178) during office hours on working days. The User Manual on the Careers Portal also explains how to fill in the form.
